comment: Turn rules (docs/ARENA.md Part 1). turnMode: move_or_act (move OR one action each turn, the default), move_then_act (move first, then one action), move_and_act (move and one action in any order). Quick cards work with either. F1 > Fights switches it mid-fight.

areaFalloff.comment: Area attacks deal this much to every target beyond the first `fullHits`.
